rule: A wallet is proven after 3+ coins and 2+ wins, with a run rate at least 15 points above average, a positive copyable return (in at the next hourly open plus 3%, out at the 24-hour close less 1%), no single trade making most of its profit, and no decay in its last 10. Snipers (first seen buying a pool under 1 hour old), bots (over 100 swaps in a read) and routers are left out. A run = +50% within 72 hours before a 30% drop.
